svg.title: F-06 guide-word scenes
svg.desc: Guide-word scenes for F-06 Plan behaviour and motion. M01 No function: No trajectory; the vehicle continues without a plan instead of stopping (H-07). M02 Stops functioning: Planning stops mid-trip; same as no function (H-07, rated as M01). M03 Unrequested function: A departure planned while the vehicle should be held; the vehicle moves off (H-05). M04 Function stuck: Trajectory frozen; the vehicle keeps going where it should slow, as in M06 (H-02, rated as M06). M05 Excessive function: Speed or acceleration planned above the intended value (H-01). M06 Partial function: Deceleration planned below what the situation needs (H-02). M07 Functions early: Proceeds before its turn at a junction, roundabout or crosswalk; enters a conflict area against right of way (H-06). M08 Functions late: Plans the stop late; as M11 (H-02, rated as M11). M09 Applies too short: Holds a stop for too short a time and moves off as in M03 (H-05, rated as M03). M10 Applies too long: Brakes for longer than needed; slows unexpectedly for following traffic, as in M13 (H-03, rated as M13). M11 Delayed: Planning latency beyond specification; braking starts too late (H-02). M12 Inverse function: Path to the wrong side; the vehicle leaves its lane (H-04). M13 Erratic or intermittent: Speed plan surges and brakes; unexpected hard decelerations for following traffic (H-03). M14 Uneven: An uneven path swerves out of the lane as in M12 (H-04, rated as M12).
svg.text: F-06 Plan behaviour and motion: what each malfunction does
WP-C-03 §6.1, Figure 6-4 (F-06): the 14 safety-related guide words, 8 rated and 6 folded into another. Schematic, not simulation results.
